###########################################
# DEA Reac vs Hom comparison of ISOL PROT
###########################################
```{r}
################
#  VOLCANO PLOT 
################

# --- STEP 1: Load the Comprehensive Unfiltered Dataset ---
de_results <- readRDS("ws/03_astro_DEA_GO/1DP_03_DEA_MCAO_Reac_WorthGentle_vs_Miltenyi.rds")

# Remove any unmapped genes or missing statistical metrics safely
de_results <- de_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_val_adj) & !is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "")


# --- STEP 2: Configure Significance Boundaries ---
fc_threshold <- 0.65

de_results$significant <- with(de_results, p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > fc_threshold)

# Group rows into discrete color channels
de_results$color_group <- ifelse(
  de_results$avg_log2FC > -fc_threshold & de_results$avg_log2FC < fc_threshold,
  "lowFC",
  ifelse(de_results$significant, "significant", "nonsig")
)


# --- STEP 3: Dynamically Isolate Top 5 Significance Drivers per Side (NO GENES FILTERED) ---
top_5_worthgentle <- de_results %>%
  filter(significant & avg_log2FC > 0) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%  # Tie-breaker for genes sharing the lowest p-value
  head(5)

top_5_miltenyi <- de_results %>%
  filter(significant & avg_log2FC < 0) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
  head(5)

# Combine target sets for point highlighting
gene_inter <- bind_rows(top_5_worthgentle, top_5_miltenyi)


# --- STEP 4: Calculate Core Dataset Statistics for Title Metadata ---
total_genes <- nrow(de_results)
deg_count   <- sum(de_results$significant, na.rm = TRUE)
deg_up      <- sum(de_results$significant & de_results$avg_log2FC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
deg_down    <- sum(de_results$significant & de_results$avg_log2FC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

subtitle_text <- paste0(
  "#DEGs: ", deg_count, " (", deg_down, " ↑ | ", deg_up, " ↑) | Total: ", total_genes,
  "\n(← UP in Miltenyi | UP in WorthGentle →)"
)


# --- STEP 5: Generate the Volcano Plot Canvas ---
p_volcano <- ggplot(data = de_results, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj))) +
  # Background gene cloud
  geom_point(aes(colour = color_group),
             alpha = 0.6,
             shape = 16,
             size  = 1) +
  
  # Highlight target points
  geom_point(data = gene_inter,
             aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj)),
             shape  = 21,
             fill   = "#444444",
             color  = "#444444",
             size   = 1.3,
             stroke = 0.3) +
             
  # --- WorthGentle Labels (Repelled in 2D to avoid collision) ---
  geom_text_repel(data = top_5_worthgentle,
                  aes(label = gene_symbol),
                  size               = 1.8,
                  box.padding        = 0.45,
                  point.padding      = 0.25,
                  color              = "#222222",
                  max.overlaps       = Inf,
                  force              = 8,
                  force_pull         = 0.6,
                  direction          = "both",       # Allows 2D repulsion to untangle clumped dots
                  nudge_x            = 1.4,
                  nudge_y            = 1.2,
                  hjust              = 0,
                  segment.size       = 0.2,
                  segment.color      = "#666666",
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  seed               = 42
  ) +
  
  # --- Miltenyi Labels (Repelled in 2D to avoid collision) ---
  geom_text_repel(data = top_5_miltenyi,
                  aes(label = gene_symbol),
                  size               = 1.8,
                  box.padding        = 0.45,
                  point.padding      = 0.25,
                  color              = "#222222",
                  max.overlaps       = Inf,
                  force              = 8,
                  force_pull         = 0.6,
                  direction          = "both",
                  nudge_x            = -1.4,
                  nudge_y            = 1.2,
                  hjust              = 1,
                  segment.size       = 0.2,
                  segment.color      = "#666666",
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  seed               = 42
  ) +
  
  # Threshold crosshairs
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "#B6C7DB", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_threshold, fc_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "#B6C7DB", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Extra margin padding so repelled labels don't get cut off at canvas borders
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    title    = "Reac WorthGentle vs. Reac Miltenyi",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x        = expression(log[2]~"fold change"),
    y        = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted "*italic(P)*"-value")
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("nonsig" = "#eadbc7", "lowFC" = "#eadbc7", "significant" = "#9f6600"),
    breaks = c("significant", "nonsig"),
    labels = c("significant DEG", "non-significant DEG")
  ) +
  theme_mk_title +
  remove_grid +
  
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key        = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)))

# Export crisp high-res tiff (slightly wider width gives 10 labels room to spread)
ggsave(
  filename    = "results/03_astro_DEA_GO/2V_03_volcano_Miltenyi_vs_WorthGentle.tiff",
  plot        = p_volcano,
  device      = "tiff",
  width       = 5.4,
  height      = 6.1,
  units       = "cm",
  dpi         = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg          = "white"
)
```

```{r}
#####################################
#  VIOLIN PLOT WITH REACTIVE MARKERS
####################################
# ==========================================
# STEP 1: FILTER TO MCAO REAC
# ==========================================
seurat_object_sub <- subset(
  seurat_object, 
  subset = Condition == "MCAO" & 
    seurat_annotated_astro == "Reac" & 
    Isolation_pub %in% c("Miltenyi", "WorthGentle")
)

# Clean up factor levels
seurat_object_sub$Isolation_pub <- droplevels(factor(seurat_object_sub$Isolation_pub, levels = c("Miltenyi", "WorthGentle")))

# ==========================================
# STEP 2: TRANSLATE & COMPUTE SINGLE MODULE SCORE
# ==========================================
my_chosen_genes <- c("Gfap", "Vim", "Cst3", "Igfbp5", "Aqp4", "C4b", "Ctsb")

# Translate Mouse Symbols to ENSEMBL IDs
chosen_genes_ensembl <- Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(my_chosen_genes)

# Ensure features are present in the active RNA matrix assay
available_features <- rownames(seurat_object_sub[["RNA"]])
valid_genes_ensembl <- intersect(chosen_genes_ensembl, available_features)

# Add single module score
set.seed(42)
seurat_object_sub <- AddModuleScore(
  object   = seurat_object_sub, 
  features = list(valid_genes_ensembl),
  name     = "Custom_Gene_Score", 
  assay    = "RNA"        
)

# ==========================================
# STEP 3: EXTRACT PLOTTING DATA FRAME
# ==========================================
plot_df <- FetchData(
  object = seurat_object_sub, 
  vars   = c("Custom_Gene_Score1", "Isolation_pub")
)
plot_df$CellID <- rownames(plot_df)

target_violin_df <- plot_df %>% 
  filter(CellID %in% colnames(seurat_object_sub)) %>% 
  mutate(Isolation_pub = factor(Isolation_pub, levels = c("Miltenyi", "WorthGentle")))

# Compute y limits cleanly without extra bracket headspace
max_y <- max(target_violin_df$Custom_Gene_Score1, na.rm = TRUE)
min_y <- min(target_violin_df$Custom_Gene_Score1, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_limit <- max_y * 1.08

# ==========================================
# STEP 4: GENERATE SINGLE PLOT CANVAS (NO SIGNIFICANCE)
# ==========================================
v_custom <- violin_boxplot(target_violin_df, "Custom_Gene_Score1", get_label("mod_score")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_list[["isol_prot"]]) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(min_y, upper_limit),
    breaks = seq(from = round(min_y * 4) / 4, to = upper_limit, by = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Reactive astrocyte markers",
    subtitle = "(MCAO Reac astrocytes)",
    x        = "Isolation Protocol",
    y        = "Module score"
  ) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 5.5, margin = margin(t = 2, b = 4)),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# ==========================================
# STEP 5: CACHE AND EXPORT PANEL TO TIFF
# ==========================================
v_custom

plots[["custom_module_violin"]] <- v_custom

ggsave(
  filename    = "results/03_astro_DEA_GO/2V_03_violin_Miltenyi_vs_WorthGentle_MCAO.tiff",               
  plot        = plots[["custom_module_violin"]],           
  device      = "tiff",                                      
  width       = 4.5,                                              
  height      = 4.5, 
  units       = "cm", 
  dpi         = 600,            
  compression = "lzw",  
  bg          = "white" 
)
```

#######
# GO
#######
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats) 
library(grid) # Natively built into base R to handle line-stripping operations

# ==========================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE STANDALONE GO OBJECTS
# ==========================================
go_worth_obj   <- readRDS("ws/03_astro_DEA_GO/1DP_03_GO_WorthGentle_UP.rds")
go_miltenyi_obj <- readRDS("ws/03_astro_DEA_GO/1DP_03_GO_Miltenyi_UP.rds")

df_worth     <- as.data.frame(go_worth_obj)
df_miltenyi  <- as.data.frame(go_miltenyi_obj)


# ==========================================
# STEP 2: PIPELINE DATA AND APPLY RANKINGS
# ==========================================
if (nrow(df_worth) > 0) {
  df_worth <- df_worth %>%
    mutate(Direction = "WorthGentle") %>%
    arrange(desc(Count), p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) 
}

if (nrow(df_miltenyi) > 0) {
  df_miltenyi <- df_miltenyi %>%
    mutate(Direction = "Miltenyi") %>%
    arrange(desc(Count), p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
}

plot_df <- rbind(df_worth, df_miltenyi)

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("Analytical Halt: Zero significant GO paths detected across both test conditions.")
}


# ==========================================
# STEP 3: FORMAT STRINGS AND ORDER THE AXIS
# ==========================================
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 45)) %>%
  arrange(Direction, Count, desc(p.adjust)) %>%
  mutate(Description = fct_inorder(Description))


# ==========================================
# STEP 4: GENERATE THE DUAL-AXIS CANVAS
# ==========================================
p_unified_go <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = "Pairwise Comparison", y = Description, size = Count, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  
  facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  
  labs(
    title = "GO terms for significant DEGs \n(Reac MCAO Ast Worth vs. Miltenyi)",
    x = NULL, 
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low  = col_list[["gradient_comp"]][1], 
    high = col_list[["gradient_comp"]][2],
    name = "p.adjust"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range  = c(0.5, 1.5), 
    name   = "Gene \ncount",
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),          # Generates clean integer steps (e.g., 15, 20, 25)
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)     # Forces whole numbers without decimals (.0)
  ) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  
  theme_mk_title +
  remove_grid +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 6, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    axis.text.x       = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x       = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 6), 
    axis.ticks.y.left  = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.length  = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 6, angle = 90, color = "black"), 
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    
    # Render the base background box frame properties
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    
    axis.line.y.left  = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y.right = element_blank(),
    
    panel.spacing.y   = unit(0.15, "cm"), 
    
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 5.5),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# --- FIXED: TARGETED LINE-STRIPPING ON PANEL BORDERS ---
p_grob <- ggplotGrob(p_unified_go)

# Identify layout locations of panels
panel_indices <- which(grepl("panel-", p_grob$layout$name))

for(idx in seq_along(panel_indices)) {
  i <- panel_indices[idx]
  border_pos <- which(grepl("panel.border", names(p_grob$grobs[[i]]$children)))
  
  if(length(border_pos) > 0) {
    # Check if this is the top box (index 1) or bottom box (index 2)
    if(idx == 1) {
      # Top box: Draw ONLY left and right vertical columns (No top or bottom lines)
      p_grob$grobs[[i]]$children[[border_pos]] <- 
        polylineGrob(
          x = unit(c(0, 0, 1, 1), "npc"), 
          y = unit(c(1, 0, 0, 1), "npc"), 
          id = c(1, 1, 2, 2), # Splitting IDs creates two separate disconnected vertical paths
          gp = gpar(col = "black", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "square")
        )
    } else {
      # Bottom box: Draw Left, Bottom, and Right lines (Leaves absolute baseline intact)
      p_grob$grobs[[i]]$children[[border_pos]] <- 
        polylineGrob(
          x = unit(c(0, 0, 1, 1), "npc"), 
          y = unit(c(1, 0, 0, 1), "npc"), 
          id = c(1, 1, 2, 2), # Single contiguous path vectors mapping a clear 'U' shape
          gp = gpar(col = "black", linewidth = 0.4, lineend = "square")
        )
    }
  }
}


# ==========================================
# STEP 5: PREVIEW AND SAVE TO DISK
# ==========================================
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(p_grob)

plots[["go_unified_facet"]] <- p_grob

ggsave(
  filename    = "results/03_astro_DEA_GO/2V_03_dotplotGO.tiff",               
  plot        = plots[["go_unified_facet"]],           
  device      = "tiff",                          
  width       = 6.5,              
  height      = 7,                                
  units       = "cm", 
  dpi         = 600,            
  compression = "lzw",  
  bg          = "white" 
)
```
